item.title: Westside incumbents draw challengers in supervisor, council races
item.description: Challengers have emerged for two Westside Los Angeles incumbents in 2026, with Tonia Arey filing against County Supervisor Lindsey Horvath and two candidates opposing City Councilwoman Traci Park as voters weigh concerns over housing, homelessness and emergency response.

item.title: Around Town: Valentine’s, Galentine’s President’s Day Weekend Happenings
item.description: From romantic dinners to Galentine's gatherings, Santa Monica offers dozens of Valentine's Day celebrations, President's Day activities, and Lunar New Year events across the Westside this weekend, including the Block Fest on the Promenade and ATTUNE at Tongva Park.

item.title: Congress Approves $94.3 Million in Mobility Funding for 2028 Olympic, Paralympic Games
item.description: The Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority has secured $94.3 million in federal funding for mobility improvements ahead of the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games. The bipartisan bill was signed into law Monday.

item.title: LA County Board Strengthens Oversight of Homeless Services Contracts
item.description: The Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors unanimously approved measures to increase accountability in homeless services contracts as the county launches its new Department of Homeless Services and Housing, addressing years of documented oversight deficiencies.

item.title: Facing ‘extinction vortex,’ California grants new protections to some mountain lions
item.description: By Rachel Becker, CalMattersThis story was originally published by CalMatters. Sign up for their newsletters.Just weeks after a mountain lion wandered into San Francisco, state officials voted to permanently protect populations of the charismatic predators that prowl the coastal mountains between the Bay Area and the Mexican border.
